title: 8 Sentences a Godly Man Stops Saying to the People He Loves
caption:
Hard on yourself. Gentle with them.

Most men flip it: easy on their own excuses, sharp with the people closest to them. Eight lines to catch before they leave your mouth.

Which one did you say this week? Save this and send it to a brother.

#faith #godlymen #christianman #relationships #gentleness #character
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
